Setup.Title: Set up Hearthpulse
Setup.Subtitle: Five short steps. You can change everything later in Settings.
Setup.OpenTip: Game logs, moving from another tracker, overlay panels, look
Setup.Logs.Title: Hearthstone writes each game to its logs
Setup.Logs.Text: Hearthpulse reads them: that is how it follows your games. It turns on the logs it needs in Hearthstone's log.config.
Setup.Logs.NotFound: Hearthstone was not found. Start it once and Hearthpulse finds it.
Setup.Logs.Fixed: Done. Hearthstone writes them from its next start.
Setup.Logs.Restart: Done. Restart Hearthstone once so it reads the new settings.
Setup.Logs.Failed: log.config could not be changed. Check that the Hearthstone folder is not read-only.
Setup.Migration.Title: Bring your games from another tracker
Setup.Migration.Text: History, decks and replays from Hearthstone Deck Tracker or Firestone. Their files are only read.
Setup.Layout.Title: Place the overlay panels
Setup.Layout.Text: Over the game, panels show your deck, the opponent's cards and Battlegrounds tips. Drag them where they suit you; in a game Ctrl+Shift+L does the same.
Setup.Look.Title: Pick a look
Setup.Look.Text: A theme colours the app and the overlay.
Setup.Done.Title: All set
Setup.Done.Text: Start Hearthstone and play a game: the overlay appears by itself, and the game lands in History.
